name: fibroblast growth factor 19

function.text: FGF19 encodes fibroblast growth factor 19. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor binding. It participates in neurogenesis and nervous system development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Hepatocellular carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
